## Interview booked -> Folk status

One trigger per interviewing partner (Sam, James, Oliver, Arjun). When a new event lands on their calendar with **interview** anywhere in the title, the applicant is matched in **Leads & Applications** and moved to **Status = Interview Booked**, with **Interview Date** set to the day of the call.

Nothing is ever created in Folk. Anything that cannot be matched, or that would move someone backwards, posts to `#-dq-n8n-errors` instead.

## Who booked, not who attended

The applicant comes from the **Booked by** block in the invite description (name on one line, email on the next), because guests they add themselves also show up as attendees.

Falls back to the name in brackets in the title, then to a single non-DQ attendee. An event with neither is skipped silently, which is what filters out internal calls that happen to say "interview".

## Matching, and never going backwards

**1. Email** - exact match in Leads & Applications.

**2. Name** - if the email is unknown, look for that name sitting at **Invited to interview**. On a single hit the booking email is added to their record and the status is set. Ambiguous or no hit means no write.

The status only moves from blank, Lead, Applied, Qualified, Invited to interview or Interview Booked. Anyone at Interview complete, Q&A, Offer sent, Closed or Unqualified is left alone and flagged in Slack, so a second call never knocks them back.
